subject: Re: Kickoff: LDS clustering for telemetry streams
body:
Anders,

Staffing through the window:

- Hyun Traore 40% research lead, owns the reproduction and the purity benchmark.
- Vera Egede 40% on the experiment harness and the telemetry sample prep for June.
- Chiara Olsen 30% April-May on packaging, then Chiara Olsen steps up to 60% for June 2026 to build the telemetry ingestion adapters — I've confirmed that allocation with her and it's the backbone of the July milestone. The adapters are the only real engineering lift in this project.

Compute: as you said, CPU-only; we'll use the shared batch pool. One environment note — the pylds dependency needs the numpy/Cython pre-install dance from the README or the build fails, so Vera is baking a container image this week to save everyone the pain.

Bao
